objects.name: chat_thread
objects.description: One named conversation in a chapter's room.

objects.name: chat_message
objects.description: One post in a chapter's room.

objects.name: chat_read_marker
objects.description: How far one member has read one thread of a chapter's room.

objects.name: chat_archive
objects.description: A thread of a chapter's room one member has set aside for themselves.

objects.name: form_thread
objects.description: One conversation about a form or one of its questions, privately between a member and the agency or among everyone the form was sent to and the agency; or about a join request, privately between the person applying and whoever decides it.

objects.name: form_message
objects.description: One message on a conversation about a form, signed by the agency when the agency answers.

objects.name: dm_thread
objects.description: One direct conversation between members, or among a group of them.

objects.name: dm_participant
objects.description: One member's standing on one direct conversation.

objects.name: dm_message
objects.description: One end-to-end encrypted message on a direct conversation.

objects.name: dm_reaction
objects.description: One member's reaction to one direct message.

objects.name: dm_device_key
objects.description: One published public key for one of a member's handsets.

objects.name: message_report
objects.description: One member asking a chapter's moderators to look at a post.

objects.name: message_removal
objects.description: A moderator withholding a post from a chapter's room.

objects.name: report_dismissal
objects.description: A moderator leaving a reported post standing.

objects.name: removal_dispute
objects.description: An author contesting the removal of their own post, decided by a chapter above the one that removed it.

objects.name: member_address
objects.description: One of a member's addresses — the handle somebody can write to without being told which member they are writing to.

objects.name: member_address_block
objects.description: One member refusing everything from one address.

objects.name: notification
objects.description: One thing that happened in the organization and that one member should be told about.

objects.name: notification_preference
objects.description: One member's decision to mute one category of notification.

objects.name: push_subscription
objects.description: One member's browser that asked to be woken when they are told something.

objects.name: push_delivery
objects.description: One attempt to wake a member's browser about something they were told, and what came of it.

objects.name: standing_message
objects.description: A message to a ward or branch that goes out on a schedule until its end or Stop.
